description: A backup file in the backups folder (/data/backups)

name.description: File name, ending in .npmpro. Scheduled files carry -s<schedule id>, automatic ones end in -auto.

modified.description: When the file was last written.

auto.description: Whether NPMpro made the file by itself before a restore, merge, page import or database move (kept in /data/backups/auto, encrypted with this instance's key).

encrypted.description: Whether the file is encrypted (with a passphrase or with this instance's key); null when the header cannot be read.

summary.description: What the file says it holds, read from its header; null when the header cannot be read.

types.description: The parts the file holds, as in the types list of POST /backups.

counts.description: Number of rows or files per part.

npmpro_version.description: The NPMpro version that made the backup.

secrets.description: Whether the file holds secrets (private keys, password hashes, credentials), encrypted.

schedule_id.description: The id of the schedule that made the file; null for a manual, uploaded or automatic file.

instance_key.description: Whether the file is encrypted with this instance's key (only this instance restores it); null when the header cannot be read.
